blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Makabayan bloc has called out the Court of Appeals for upholding the conviction for child abuse of the so-called Talaingod 13 — which includes former lawmakers from progressive groups — saying that the move only sends a message that rescuing children is a crime. In a statement on Friday, Makabayan lawmakers ACT Teachers party-list Rep. Antonio Tinio, Gabriela party-list Rep. Sarah Elago, and Kabataan party-list Rep. Renee Co said the denial of the Talaingod 13’s motion for reconsideration is a wrong decision since the activists only responded to children’s call for distress. Former Bayan Muna Rep. Satur […]...
